Existing automation invoking `thor disqus:import -c SomeCategory` now aborts with Thor's unknown-option error before importing anything, and imported threads can no longer be placed into a category; nothing in the diff migrates or documents the removed capability.

adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly removes `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` from `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` and also deletes the `category_id` lookup/assignment that previously used `options[:category]` to set `category:` in `PostCreator.new(...)`. The new code calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` with no category handling. With Thor, removing the option means `thor disqus:import -c SomeCategory` will now fail with an unknown-option error before running, and there is no replacement path in the diff to place imported threads into a category.
